text: Create professional presentations directly through your AI agent. This is Slide Agent.
Add Slide Agent to a supported agent, like Codex or Claude Code.
Describe the presentation you need. Your agent designs it and builds the deck.
Preview the slides together. A consistent look, clear layouts, and substance across the presentation.
Want a change? Ask your agent. Here, a new headline keeps the same design.
Different topics. Different looks. Project updates, technical reviews, and data stories.
Export an editable PowerPoint, ready for your next presentation.
Explore examples and installation instructions at slide-agent dot ghassen dot io.
